multiplexer.description: Terminal multiplexer to use for session orchestration ('tmux', 'herdr', or 'auto')

preset.description: Preset name or module path. Omitted layout, workspace, setup, and cleanup settings inherit from this preset. Relative module paths resolve from the configuration file.

worktreesBase.description: Base directory where worktrees should be placed (e.g. '/path/to/worktrees')

defaultBaseBranch.description: Default base branch to branch off (e.g. 'develop', 'prod', 'main')

protectedBranches.description: Array of branch names protected against deletion during --nuke

workspace.description: Workspace/session naming, agent, and focus configuration

labelPrefix.description: Prefix added to workspace/session labels (e.g. '[BE] '). Does not change the layout, agent, or focus.

agent.description: Explicit command override for agent panes ('codex', 'agy', 'claude', 'aider', 'copilot', 'none', or custom command object). Omit to use the selected preset or custom layout commands; null disables the agent command.

title.description: Display title for the agent pane in terminal multiplexer

defaultFocus.description: Default pane to focus upon creation ('agent', 'agy', 'claude', 'vim', 'logs', 'server', 'shell')

layout.description: Optional complete layout override. Omit to inherit the preset layout; supply an array only when customizing panes.

id.description: Unique identifier for this pane within the layout

title.description: Title displayed on the terminal pane

cmd.description: Command to run when pane is opened (e.g. 'vim .', 'npm run dev', 'tail -f ...')

position.description: Set to 'root' for the initial root pane

from.description: ID of parent pane to split from

focus.description: Whether this pane should receive focus by default

isAgent.description: Whether this pane is designated as the AI CLI agent pane

setup.description: Shell command(s) executed in the workspace directory upon creating a new workspace

cleanup.description: Shell command(s) executed in the workspace directory upon removing a workspace

envSource.description: Path to .env source file to copy into new worktree

symlink.description: Path to web server symlink to update to active worktree

install.description: Command to run to install dependencies upon creation
